+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from .models import Note
+
+
+def save(note: Note, path: str) -> None:
+    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps({"id": note.id, "text": note.text}))
+
+
+def load(path: str) -> Note:
+    data = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
+    return Note(id=data["id"], text=data["text"])
